==Not a member of the post-schism Hall==
This article mentions that Rina Hafden remains a Sitter for the post-schism Hall and cites Towers of Midnight, Ch 27 as a source. However, that exact reference makes it clear that the Green Sitters are Rubinde, Faiselle and Farnah. Before the line here gets editted out, can anyone else spot anything in ToM 27 that would somehow support Rina still being in the Hall somehow? I wouldn't hesistate to make the edit if there hadn't been a specific annotations supporting Rina being in the Hall in the first place.
